'''Amir D'Vail''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who operated [[House D'Vails]], a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] house that was based in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Taggon]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]]. D'Vail was friends with the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] trader [[Renna (Rodian)|Renna]] and in about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he placed an order with [[Renna's Transport Service]] to take delivery of a cargo of [[Naescorcom/Legends|Naescorcom]] [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]].
